questions.question: One kg of an ideal gas (gas constant, R = 400 J/kg.K; specific heat at constant volume,[latex]c_{\textrm{v}}[/latex] =1000 J / kg .K) at 1 bar, and 300 K is contained in a sealed rigid cylinder. During an adiabatic process, 100kJ of work is done on the system by a stirrer. The increase in entropy of the system is _________ J/K.
questions.explanation: [latex]m=1 \mathrm{kg} ; \quad R=400 \mathrm{J} / \mathrm{kg}-\mathrm{k}[/latex] [latex] \begin{aligned} c_{v}&=1000 \mathrm{J} / \mathrm{kg}-\mathrm{K} \\ T_{i}&=300 \mathrm{K} ; P_{i}=100 \mathrm{kPa} \\ W&=100 \mathrm{kJ} \end{aligned}[/latex] Applying first law: [latex] \begin{aligned} Q&=\Delta U+W\\ \Rightarrow \quad 0&=m c_{v}\left(T_{f}-T_{i}\right)+(-100) \times 10^{3} J \\ \Rightarrow \quad 0&=1 \times 1000 \times\left(T_{f}-300\right)-100 \times 10^{3} \\ \Rightarrow \quad T_{f}&=400 \mathrm{K} \end{aligned}[/latex] Entropy change for ideal gas [latex] \begin{aligned} \Delta S &=m\left[C_{v} \ln \frac{T_{f}}{T_{i}}+R \ln \frac{V_{f}}{V_{i}}\right] \quad \because V_{i}=V_{f} \\ &=1 \times\left[1000 \ln \frac{400}{300}+0\right] \\ &=287.682 \mathrm{J} / \mathrm{K} \end{aligned}[/latex]

questions.question: A strip of 120 mm width and 8 mm thickness is rolled between two 300 mm-diameter rolls to get a strip of 120 mm width and 7.2 mm thickness. The speed of the strip at the exit is 30 m/min. There is no front or back tension. Assuming uniform roll pressure of 200 MPa in the roll bite and 100% mechanical efficiency, the minimum total power (in kW) required to drive the two roll is _______.
questions.explanation: Method-1: Projected length, [latex] \begin{aligned} L_{p} &=R \sin \alpha \approx \sqrt{R \Delta h} \\ &=\sqrt{150 \times(8-7.2)}=10.954 \mathrm{mm} \end{aligned}[/latex] Projected Area, [latex] \begin{aligned} A_{p} &=L_{p} \times b=10.954 \times 120 \\ &=1314.48 \mathrm{mm}^{2} \end{aligned}[/latex] Roll Separating Force, [latex] \begin{aligned} F &=\sigma_{0} \times L_{p} \times b N \\ &=200 \times 1314.48 \mathrm{N}=262.9 \mathrm{kN}\\ &\left[\sigma_{o} \text { in } N / m m^{2} \text { i.e. } M P a\right] \\ \text{ Arm length (a in mm)}&=0.5 L_{p} \text{for hot rolling}\\ &=0.5 \times 10.954 \mathrm{mm}=5.477 \mathrm{mm}\\ &=0.45 L_{p} \;\text{for cold rolling }\\ \end{aligned}[/latex] Torque per roller, [latex] \begin{aligned} T &=F \times \frac{a}{1000} \mathrm{Nm} \\ &=262.9 \mathrm{kN} \times 5.477 \mathrm{mm} \\ &=1439.9 \mathrm{Nm} \end{aligned}[/latex] Total power for two roller, [latex] P=2 T \omega \text { in } W=2 T \times \frac{2 \pi N}{60}[/latex] For the calculation of N we need velocity of  neutral plane Continuity equation [latex] \begin{aligned} h_{0} b_{0} v_{0} &=h_{f} b_{f} v_{f} \\ 8 \times 120 \times v_{0} &=7.2 \times 120 \times 30 \\ \text{or}\quad v_{0} &=27 \mathrm{m} / \mathrm{min} \end{aligned}[/latex] Assuming velocity of neutral plane average velocity, [latex] \begin{aligned} V &=\frac{V_{0}+V_{f}}{2}=\frac{27+30}{2} \\ &=28.5 \mathrm{m} / \mathrm{min}\\ \text{Now,}V&=\pi D N\\ \text{or}\quad 28.5&=\pi \times 0.300 \times N\\ \text{or}\quad N&=30.24 \mathrm{rpm} \end{aligned}[/latex] [latex] \therefore [/latex]  Total power for two roller, [latex] \begin{aligned} P &=2 T \times \frac{2 \pi N}{60} \\ &=2 \times 1439.9 \times \frac{2 \times \pi \times 30.24}{60} \mathrm{W} \\ &=9.1195 \mathrm{kW} \approx 9.12 \mathrm{kW} \end{aligned}[/latex] Method-II : Velocity at the neutral plane =? [latex] \begin{aligned} H_{n} V_{n}&=H_{2} V_{2} \quad(\text { Applying continuity }) \\ H_{n}&=H_{2}+0.25 \Delta H\\ &\text{(Standard relation)}\\ &=7.2+0.25 \times 0.8=7.4 \mathrm{mm} \\ V_{n}&=\frac{\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{V}_{2}}{\mathrm{H}_{n}}=29.19 \mathrm{m} / \mathrm{min} \\ N&=\frac{29.19 \times 1000}{\pi \times 300}=30.98 \mathrm{rpm}\\ \text{total power }&=2 T \omega \\ &=2 \times 1439.9 \times 2 \pi \frac{30.98}{60} \\ &=9.34 \mathrm{kW} \end{aligned}[/latex]
